protocol.purpose: Small development-only longer-preview/sequence headroom diagnostic; no training or automatic selection
protocol.cadence: All proposal policies update at most every5 ticks when worker accepts; held proposal used between updates. Identical actual gate, sensor, service-delay and physical limits. This cadence differs from original teacher every available tick and must be disclosed.
protocol.teacher: 3 independent forecast branches zero/+Gaussian/-Gaussian; no actual future measurement noise. Privileged current state/parameters; exact known path.
protocol.search: hold20: five constant proposals over20 ticks; hold40: five over40 ticks; sequence40: rank first actions by hold40 costs, retain top2, enumerate five second proposals for each after20 ticks. Execute only first proposal then replan. Not exhaustive or an upper bound.
protocol.cost: Sum lateral squared error, failure fills remaining branch tail with6.25 per tick. Select minimum, abstain zero unless benefit over all-zero branch >max(1e-7,0.001*zero_cost); ties smaller absolute first action.
protocol.report: All72 episodes and all per-region/two-noise means; >=5% reduction against paired LQR is descriptive screen only. Preserve survival and exact100ms fallback. No significance, unseen-path/native/safety or global-ceiling claim.
protocol.stop: Stop after this one diagnostic regardless of outcome. No post-result tuning, training, gate change, reserved evaluation or promotion.
